answer: Proof of Stake acts as a rigorous Sybil resistance mechanism by requiring agents to lock capital to participate in consensus. An attacker cannot simply wander into the network to spin up illicit nodes, as the cost of acquiring enough stake becomes an onyx barrier of financial risk. By forcing actors to put skin in the game, the protocol ensures that reaching the economic ridge of majority control requires prohibitive expenditure, rendering large-scale identity fabrication irrational for profit-seeking entities.
